{{Quote|Stewed Dressellian prunes 2.7 credits|The pricing on Dex's menu for the prunes|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''Dressellian prunes''' were a type of edible [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]]. The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] considered stewed Dressellian prunes delicious and served them as a breakfast side dish for 2.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] at his [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The diner also served Dressellian prune fruit juice, with a small glass costing 1.75 credits and a large glass costing 2.5 credits.<ref name="DaD" /> Both offerings including Dressellian prunes were sold at Dex's at some point prior to the destruction of the diner in the first two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] reign.<ref name="DexEra">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]'' established that [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] was destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' later stated that the novel took place around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' states that the Empire was formed in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], so Dex's Diner was destroyed either during 19 BBY or 18 BBY.</ref> [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellians]] were a [[Species/Legends|species]] with wrinkled skin native to the planet [[Dressel/Legends|Dressel]].<ref name="GG">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Dressellian prunes were first mentioned in the [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] exclusive article, "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]]. The connection, if any, between the prunes and the Dressellians is not made clear in the article itself,<ref name="DaD" /> although the species was referred to as "prune-face" on the set of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="db">{{DB|character|orrimaarko|Orrimaarko}}</ref> Walker clarified on his [[Star Wars Blog]] that it was indeed a reference to the nickname prune-face. He described the reference as one step up from a bad pun.<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>
